verdict.rationale: Firebase documents programmatic interfaces of its own: a MongoDB-compatible API for Cloud Firestore, Authentication SDK methods for creating and managing users, and an Admin SDK. A community report also confirms customers drive Firebase through its REST API. However, the pack contains no first-party REST API reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so the depth of the public API surface is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party REST/management API reference documentation, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, API coverage beyond Firestore and Auth data operations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Cloud Firestore offers a MongoDB-compatible API.
